summary: Nintendo's plant-creature strategy/puzzle series, covering the four main entries, Switch remasters, handheld and mobile spinoffs, and the browser-based AR Pikmin Finder.

entries.title: Pikmin

emulation.emulator: None for primary / Dolphin for GameCube-Wii
emulation.notes: Use Switch for the primary; Dolphin is a preservation fallback for original/Wii versions.

primary.why: The Switch remaster is the highest-fidelity official route for the first Pikmin and includes modern access and optional motion controls while preserving the original adventure.
primary.how_to_play: Play Pikmin 1 through the Pikmin 1+2 bundle on Nintendo Switch.

all_releases.reason: skip: authentic original, but superseded by Switch remaster for fidelity/access.
skip: useful control variant, but lower fidelity than Switch remaster.

all_releases.fidelity: HD Switch remaster with optional motion controls.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch is the best official fidelity route for the same core game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use GameCube or Wii only for original hardware/control comparison.

entries.title: Pikmin 2

emulation.emulator: None for primary / Dolphin for GameCube-Wii
emulation.notes: Use Switch for the primary; Dolphin is a preservation fallback.

primary.why: The Switch remaster is the highest-fidelity official route for Pikmin 2 and is bundled with the first game as Pikmin 1+2.
primary.how_to_play: Play Pikmin 2 through the Pikmin 1+2 bundle on Nintendo Switch.

all_releases.reason: skip: authentic original, but superseded by Switch remaster for modern play.
skip: control variant, but lower fidelity than Switch remaster.

all_releases.fidelity: HD Switch remaster with optional motion controls.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch is the modern official fidelity route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use older releases only for original hardware/control comparison.

entries.title: Pikmin 3

emulation.emulator: None for primary / Cemu for Wii U original
emulation.notes: Use Switch for Deluxe; Cemu only for original Wii U preservation.

primary.why: Pikmin 3 Deluxe adds new Olimar/Louie side-story content, story co-op, and the original DLC stages, making it the most complete official version over the Wii U release.
primary.how_to_play: Play Pikmin 3 Deluxe on Nintendo Switch.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Wii U release with DLC sold separately.
all_releases.reason: skip: superseded by Deluxe for content and modern access.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced Switch port with added side stories, co-op story mode, and DLC content included.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Deluxe is the more complete and modern route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wii U GamePad-specific context is historical; Deluxe is the recommended play version.

emulation.notes: 3DS emulation can increase resolution; real hardware preserves the intended stereoscopic handheld context.

primary.why: Hey! Pikmin is the series' handheld side-scrolling 3DS spinoff and has no port or enhanced edition.
primary.how_to_play: Play Hey! Pikmin on Nintendo 3DS hardware or a legally dumped copy in 3DS emulation.

entries.title: Pikmin Bloom

primary.why: Pikmin Bloom is the series' Niantic-developed mobile walking/spin-off game and is only officially available on smart devices.
primary.how_to_play: Install Pikmin Bloom on a compatible iOS or Android device in a supported region.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single mobile platform family; live-service content changes over time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service features, events, and availability can change.

entries.title: Pikmin 1+2

primary.why: Pikmin 1+2 is the Switch bundle/remaster release of the first two games, making it the best official package for the GameCube-era pair.

all_releases.fidelity: HD Switch bundle of Pikmin 1 and Pikmin 2 with optional motion controls.
all_releases.reason: primary: only release of this bundle and best official package for the first two games.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: This is the current official bundle for the first two games.

entries.remaster_caveats: Individual early-game entries still note original GameCube and Wii releases separately.

primary.why: Pikmin 4 is a Switch-exclusive mainline entry; the latest updated version adds Decor Pikmin, Field Camera, and Relaxed/Fierce creature activity options, making the current patched Switch release the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Pikmin 4 on Nintendo Switch with the latest update installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Switch mainline release with post-launch free update content.
all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete updated version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single-platform release; install the latest update for complete content.

entries.title: Pikmin Finder

emulation.notes: Requires compatible mobile browser/camera access if still live.

primary.why: Pikmin Finder is a browser-based augmented-reality mobile game released around Nintendo Live 2023 and has no separate app or console port.
primary.how_to_play: Play in a compatible mobile browser if Nintendo's web experience is still available; otherwise treat as a limited-time web preservation entry.

all_releases.fidelity: Browser-based AR game using mobile camera.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented official release route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Availability may be limited because it is a web/AR experience tied to Nintendo promotional distribution.
